searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Free-text CKAN searches, e.g. "property sales", "land use planning". One per item.

datasetIds.title: Dataset IDs or slugs
datasetIds.description: Specific dataset ids/slugs to fetch directly (package_show), bypassing search.

baseUrl.title: CKAN portal base URL
baseUrl.description: CKAN API root. Default is data.gov.au. Point it at another CKAN portal (e.g. https://discover.data.vic.gov.au) to reuse this actor elsewhere.

maxDatasets.title: Max datasets per query
maxDatasets.description: Cap on datasets returned per search query.

fetchRecords.title: Fetch data rows
fetchRecords.description: Also pull the actual rows from each dataset's resources (DataStore API for structured resources; direct CSV/JSON download otherwise). XLSX/PDF resources are left as URLs.

maxRecordsPerResource.title: Max rows per resource
maxRecordsPerResource.description: Row cap per resource when Fetch data rows is on.

resourceFormats.title: Resource format filter
resourceFormats.description: Only keep resources of these formats (e.g. CSV, JSON, GEOJSON). Empty = all formats.
